evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around 1015 minutes, then I will be able to build you an accurate code. You can depend on sounds good.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: The move date is October 16th... items are a bed, bed furniture, a couch... moving from a one story house with three bedrooms... address for pickup is 129-1420 way Houston, Texas. 77047 and you're moving to a apartment located in 13220. FM, 973 mano, Texas, 78653
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.no_two_layers_deep: Customer stated 'I just need a quote, that's all I'm comparing quotes' — no concerns raised that would trigger follow-up.
evidence_quotes.no_reflection: No concerns raised by customer, so no reflection needed.
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Property type (one story house), bedrooms (1 bed, 2 bedrooms after clarification), rooms usage (bedroom and office), walking distance to truck (implicitly covered), additional rooms (none), special considerations (third floor apartment, need wrapping/reassembly), additional stops (none).
evidence_quotes.box_count: For a typical 1600 square footage home we usually expect to see around fifty to sixty boxes to move. Do you think you'll fall within that range?... no more than twenty, less than twenty.
evidence_quotes.packing_not_offered: No packing services offer was made.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For a typical 1600 square footage home it usually takes around seven to nine hours... I will estimate this move to take around eight to nine hours with two movers and one truck... It's good to budget around $2,640 to $2,844
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: We charge $204 per hour... travel fee of $768... overnight fee of $240... Everything is included in the hourly rate, like the fuel and truck taxes, insurance... There's only two things outside of the hourly rate... no hidden fees of any type... We have a minimum of two and a half hours once we go over the minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.no_feels_fair_silence: After pricing, rep says 'to secure a spot, there's no deposit required if you have to reschedule or cancel no fees for that either. And would you like our help with your move?' — no pause asking 'does that feel fair?' before the ask.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: If we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange. We immediately start discounting money of your final bill and the way the clock works is the time start as soon as we get on site and open the contract
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: we have no worries, damage coverage, we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.no_closes_loop: Rep does not ask 'does that put those to rest?' or similar; moves directly to 'And would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_throwaway: And do you have any other questions or anything for me? — empty throwaway question
evidence_quotes.no_catch_all: No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: And would you like our help with your move?

top_strength: Nicole delivered a complete, transparent pricing explanation with all fees disclosed upfront (hourly rate, travel fee, overnight fee, included items, minimum hours, and increments) and covered both promises (On-Time Guarantee with discount terms and No Worries Damage Coverage with $2,000 no-deductible framing) early and fully.
coaching_note: After the estimate, ask 'Does that feel fair?' and hold genuine silence before pivoting to the ask; also move from the final concerns check to a stronger version ('What's still concerning you about this move?') and add the catch-all ('Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?') before attempting to close, and always confirm booking details (date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses, notes) if the customer says yes.
